rooms.name: Burning Sands
rooms.desc:
You stand parched amidst the shifting, burning sands just southwest of
the walled city of Xixieqi.
   Here, an occasional scorpion digs itself out from the sand to chitter
at other insects while eyeless desert voles leave ridged paths just beneath
the surface of the sand which extends in all directions.
   To the north only burnt-sienna sands can be seen, making travel in that
direction rather pointless, as it appears to be only a wasteland and dump
for the city to the northeast.  To the south, the desert stretches into wave
like dunes, matched only by the stetches of desert to the east.  A beach 
appears to the west, leading into the ocean.

rooms.name: Burning Coastal Sands
rooms.desc:
You stand parched amidst the shifting, burning sands of Xixieqi.  Here,
a few desert cacti provide meager shade for the white, eyeless desert voles
that live within the spiny, pulpy interior.
   To the north, south, and east, the desert continues, while to the west,
the burnt-sienna sands stretch toward the ocean, where the salt-saturated
waters pound the sandy coast and destroy any plant life.

rooms.name: Searing Sands
rooms.desc:

   To the north, south, and east, the desert continues, while off to the

rooms.desc:

rooms.name: Searing Sands
rooms.desc:
You stand parched amidst the shifting, burning sands of Xixieqi.  Here,
a few desert cacti provide meager shade for scorpions and voles that hide
in their shade during the day and offer protection from the wind at night.
   To the north, south, and east, the desert continues, while off to the
west, a tall cliff rises over the ocean, offering a spectacular view of
the waters below.

rooms.name: Saltfall
rooms.desc:
You are wading through a sandfall.  Here, flowing salt from the heat-
risen flats to the south and east flow over the cliff and into the water
to the west, forming an enormous white sandfall.
   The flats continue to the east and south while the desert becomes more
sandy to the north.

rooms.name: Saltfall
rooms.desc:
You are wading through a sandfall current.  Here, flowing salt from the
heat-risen flats to the north and east flow over the edge of the cliff here
to the west to form an enormous white sandfall.
   The flats continue to the east and north while the desert becomes more
sandy to the distant north.  To the south you can see some grass emerging
from the lip of the desert salts.

rooms.name: Ghant's Hillock
rooms.desc:
You are standing on what appears to have once been an ancient desert
outpost.  Here, a large grass-covered mound stand surrounded by a crumbled
wall that has been swallowed by the lush grasses that obscure it from view
from afar.
   No matter what may have changed, the view is spectacular.  To the far
northwest you can see clearly into the ocean and the cliff that forms
the desert border, while to the north and east you can see the great desert
of Xixieqi.  Behind you to the south, foothills rise high and gradually blend
into a tall row of snow-capped peaks.

road several miles away.

rooms.name: Burning Sands
rooms.desc:

   The desert sands continue in all directions.

rooms.name: Burning Sands
rooms.desc:
You stand parched amidst the shifting, searing sands of Xixieqi.
A few prickly pear cacti dot the sandy ground, offering some small
amount of protection for snakes, scorpions, and desert rats that 
live beneath the spiny leaves.
   In all directions, the desert continues, stretching infinitely
and offering little in solace against the desolation.

rooms.name: Dunes
rooms.desc:
Sands shift and move in waves here as the strong desert winds pile
the burning grains into shapeless dunes.
   There is no sign of life here, only bleak, burnished sands and dead,
rotting tumbleweed.
   The desert continues in all directions.

rooms.name: Dunes
rooms.desc:
Sands shift and move in waves here as the strong desert winds pile
the burning grains into shapeless dunes that blend with the salt flats
to the south.
   The desert continues all around you.

rooms.name: Salt Flats
rooms.desc:
Here, the desert sands and silt have given way to broad flats of
natural salt.  Chunks of the hardened stones lay caked across the
desert, some cracked and rising above the surface to form obstacles
through which you must walk.
   The desert continues to the north while the salt flats continue
in all other directions.

rooms.name: Salt Flats
rooms.desc:

   A grassy field marks the border of the flats to the south, while
the flats continue to the north, east, and west.

rooms.name: Grassy Fields
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a grassy field, where the desert to the north meets
the foothills to the far south.  The breezes are both warm and damp here,
clear indications that this place receives a fair amount of downhill rains
and runoff.
   Immediately to the north salt flats have made plant growth impossible
as it forms an effective barrier against flora for the desert, while lush
grasses span the fields to the east and west at the base of the southern
foothills.

rooms.name: Dunes
rooms.desc:
Sands shift and move in waves here as the strong desert winds pile
the burning grains into amorphous dunes.
   Beneath the moving dunes, a few desert rodents leave raised paths
that make the surface of the sands apear to be alive with pulsing
veins and arteries.
   To the north, you can see an overturned wagon.  Sand has sloped gently
against it, forming an artificial drift, a haven for scorpions and other
hazards.  You quickly decide to avoid it.  To the south and west, the
desert stretches into near-infinity, while far to the east, a caravan
trail leads into the city to the northeast.

rooms.name: Outside The City Gates
rooms.desc:
You stand just outside the gates of an enormous desert city.  Tall,
sand-blasted walls rise high above you, sloping gently and slightly
inward to deflect the sand from settling within.
   Tanned guards patrol around you as they inspect desert caravans
that come in from the south, occasionally taking a bribe as they allow
a few black-market items into the city.
   All around you, the desert spans as far as you can see, an errant
whirlwind or dust devil whipping about the sand.
   To the east and west, the desert stretches without limit, while
to the south, a worn caravan road leads into the desert.

rooms.name: Caravan Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a caravan road that winds through the desert.
Warm breezes blow across the sand, cooling your skin and making the
desert seem less desolate.
   The desert continues to the east and west, split only by this
road that runs to the south.  To the north you can see the gates of
a small city.

rooms.name: Caravan Trail
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a caravan road that exits the desert to the
south where it climbs higher in elevation and enters some plains
and foothills.
   To the east and west, flanking the road, the desert gives birth
to a set of salt flats.  Even from here, the strong, briny scent 
brings tears to your eyes.
   The caravan road continues north through the desert.

rooms.name: Caravan Trail
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a caravan road that overlooks the desert to the
north.  Here, a few wagon tracks lie embedded in the dirt road and head
southward toward the hills and far-distant mountains beyond.
   All across the northern horizon, a desert stretches under the open
sky, bordered to the east and west by patches of grass and yellowish,
grassy fields.

rooms.name: Parched Sands

traverse this patch of dry sand.  A few wind clouds blast into you,
filling your nose and ears with stinging debris as hot winds draw
the energy from your body.
   The desert stretches in all directions, save the north where a
city wall appears, and the west, where a caravan trail that leads
from it, heading south.

rooms.name: Sandstone Monoliths
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a desert valley.  All around you, gigantic pillars
of weathered sandstone spike high into the air, casting cooler shadows
on the groundling pear cacti beneath them.
   Looking around you, you notice that water-weathered rocks line this
valley, as though this was an ancient streambed that was consumed by
desert heat.
   The monoliths themselves are wonderous.  Rising nearly a thousand
feet in the air, these red and yellow-banded titans are all that
remain of a prehistoric mountain range, judging by the symmetry of the
remaining spires.  Time, weather, and wind appear to have blown
holes through these ancient mountain walls, leaving the banded monoliths
you see throughout the east.
   To the north the desert gives way to the ocean, where more of the
monolithic spires rise against you, while to the south and west, the
sandstone pillars decay into the desert sands.  The scent of the sea is
powerful here.  The ocean must lay to the north, behind the sandstone giants.

gently upward as it ends at the hills to the west.

   The desert continues to the north, south, and west, but gives
way to savanna grasses to the east.

rooms.name: Parched Sands
rooms.desc:
Warm winds blow as you trek across the desert sands.  The desert
stretches to the north, south, and west, offering nothing in terms
of shelter or water until you head east toward to the less harsh
plains of the savanna.

rooms.name: Parched Sands
rooms.desc:
Warm winds blow as you scan the desert, wary of desert raiders and
unexpected dust storms.  The desert stretches to the north, south, and
west, offering nothing in terms of comfort or relief from a parched
throat or throbbing feet.
   The desert gives way to rich savanna grasses to the east.

rooms.name: Parched Sands
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the edge of a parched desert.  Desert winds blow
warmly across the sand, carrying the faint scent of blooming cacti and
salt.  The scent seems to be stronger from the south.
   The desert continues to the north, south, and west, becoming more
fertile in the grasslands just east of here.

rooms.name: Salt Flats
rooms.desc:
Here, the desert sands and silt have given way to broad flats of
natural salt and, to the east, wide fields of grass.  Chunks of the
hardened salt bricks lay caked across the desert to the west and south,
some cracked and rising above the surface to form hazardous obstacles
across which to walk.
   The desert continues to the north and northwest while the salt flats
continues to the south and southwest. 
   A grassy field lies to the east.

rooms.name: Salt Flats
rooms.desc:
Here, the desert sands and silt have given way to broad flats of
natural salt.  Chunks of the hardened stones lay caked across the
desert, some cracked and rising above the surface to form hazardous
obstacles across which to walk.
   The flats continue in all directions, gently giving way to rising
hills and grassy fields to the south and east.

rooms.name: Grassy Fields
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a grassy field, where the desert to the north meets
the foothills to the far south.  The breezes are both warm and damp here,
indications that this place receives a fair amount of downhill rains and
runoff.
   Immediately to the north salt flats have made plant growth impossible
as it forms an effective barrier against flora for the desert.  To the
east and west, the grassy field continues, adding a freshness to the air
that sweeps down from the hills to the south.

rooms.name: Within A Monolith
rooms.desc:
Sheltered from the harsh winds of the desert, this hollow in the stone
monolith appears to have carved by tools, rather than weather.  Charred
tinder and a ring of stones rest in the center of the sandy floor that
blankets the interior of this internal spire.
   Above you, a tediously long series of carved steps rises hundreds of
feet to a narrow, conical chamber that overlooks the floor you stand on.

rooms.name: Savanna Grasses
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the edge of a desert where rich savanna grasses
form the border between the rugged sandy desert and the scrub of the
grasslands.  The sounds of groundling birds and animals seem to offer
the last signs of life before entering the western desert.
   To the north the ocean nurtures the coastal grasses and clashes
against a large sandstone monolith, as it soothes the reeds and grasses
from the harsh, hot desert winds to the southwest.

rooms.name: Savanna Grasses
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the edge of a desert where rich savanna grasses
form the border between the rugged sandy desert and the scrub of the
grasslands.  The sounds of groundling birds and animals seem to offer
the last signs of life before entering the western desert.
   To the far north a sandstone monolith offers a buffer against the
desert winds, though there is clearly no way to pass or climb it.
The desert continues to the south and west, while the savanna grasses
continue to the north and east.

rooms.desc:

savanna grasses form the border between the rugged desert and the
scrub of the grasslands.
   The desert continues to the west, while the richer plains of the
savanna continue to the north, south, and east.

rooms.name: Grassy Fields
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a grassy field, where the desert to the northwest
the grassy hills of the south and east.  The breezes are both warm and
damp here, indications that this place receives a fair amount of rain
and runoff from the higher elevations to the south and east.
   To the east and west, the grassy fields continue, adding a freshness
to the air.

rooms.name: The Peak Of The Monolith
rooms.desc:
Though still several hundred feet below the top of the spire, you have
reached the highest point in the hollow interior.  Here, a small platform,
perhaps once carved by dwarven hands, looks out over the floor below.
   A few old bones litter the floor here, some with unfinished carvings,
as though some desert wandered tried to whittle away some time during the
desert night.
   Below you, a set of carved stairs leads down into the main floor of the
spire.

rooms.name: Rich Savanna Grasses
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the edge of a desert where rich savanna grasses
form the border between the rugged sandy desert and the scrub of the
grasslands.  The sounds of groundling birds and animals seem to offer
the last signs of life before entering the western desert.
   To the north the ocean thunders against the coast, while to the 
south, the grasslands continue become more dry as it gives way to the
desert to the west.

and south.  The grasses are high here as they rise out of the northern
savanna and grow taller as they lead up the hills to the south.
